summary.text: Human Executing Heaven’s Work is a killer move Star Constellation Immortal Venerable created. It is built on the foundation of heaven-human sensation and allows a Gu Immortal to replace heaven's will to a certain degree.

claims.text: Fang Yuan looks into the heaven path research results Qin Ding Ling hands over. Among them he sees this killer move together with heaven-human sensation. Precisely because of these two killer moves, Star Constellation’s will could interfere and affect heaven’s will, and even control fate Gu, allowing Heavenly Court a decisive rule for three million years. He senses that the two moves are the key to breaking out of his current predicament.

Inside Dragon Palace, Fang Yuan sits on the ground modifying heaven-human sensation and this killer move. He lacks more than half of the Gu worms they need. Immortal Gu are unique, and the two moves are newly obtained, so modification is difficult. He gives up on the Immortal Gu level and targets the aspect of a mortal killer move. He connects to treasure yellow heaven and gathers the relevant mortal Gu worms. After modifying the move from an immortal killer move to a mortal killer move, the difficulty becomes nearly nonexistent. With these two mortal killer moves he stops the formation in the sovereign immortal aperture that had been using qi tides to cleanse the immortal aperture’s nine heavens and five regions. Heaven’s will is produced. He sends a portion of his will toward it, activates heaven-human sensation, fuses into heaven’s will, then activates this move. After a while his eyes shine: he has sensed a certain group of heaven path dao marks. If he had to replace the word sensed, he would choose caught. Originally he knew about the heaven path dao marks in his body but could only let them be. Now that he can sense them, they are under his control temporarily.

Fang Yuan’s main body is deep inside Dragon Palace, researching Heavenly Court’s heaven path research results and fighting against time. He activates the immortal killer move heaven-human sensation, then the immortal killer move Human Executing Heaven’s Work. Within the sovereign immortal aperture his will mixes with heaven’s will and he senses various heaven path dao marks. He then activates unrestrained heavenly mark, expends rank eight immortal essence rapidly, and quickly refines three heaven path dao marks.

To refine heaven path dao marks he has to mingle with heaven’s will and use both heaven-human sensation and this move to capture their location, then use unrestrained heavenly mark to refine the relevant heaven path dao marks. Heaven’s will is necessary for that process. If he used heaven’s will dissipation and got rid of heaven’s will, he would also be unable to refine those dao marks.

Fang Yuan stands outside the entrance of Shi Zong’s blessed land. He cannot go in. After totems shred the yellow sky dust cloud, he activates the immortal killer move heaven-human sensation, the immortal killer move Human Executing Heaven’s Work, and the immortal killer move unrestrained heavenly mark from outside the entrance, refining all the heaven path dao marks from the grand tribulation. The unrestrained heavenly marks fall on Shi Zong’s blessed land.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable had merged with heaven’s will of her own accord. This killer move was extremely profound. While she altered heaven’s will, she was also comprehending heaven path. Limitless Demon Venerable competed with her to extract heaven path mysteries, and also received the help of this wisdom path supreme grandmaster to deduce new heaven path research results.

Fang Yuan’s foundation in heaven path is actually very weak. He has only cultivated it for a short time. All of his foundation was obtained from predecessors, for example Star Constellation Immortal Venerable’s human executing heaven’s work, or Limitless Demon Venerable’s unrestrained heavenly mark killer move.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable and Limitless Demon Venerable had cooperated for a million years to maintain the Crazed Demon formation. She even assimilated with the Dao and created this killer move. Fang Yuan holds that she definitely knew unsealing the truthful floating ice required immortal essence.
